description: Hillsborough County's local administration of the Florida SHIP program. Provides down-payment and closing-cost assistance as a deferred-payment second mortgage to income-qualified first-time buyers purchasing in unincorporated Hillsborough County.
eligibility_criteria: First-time homebuyer (no ownership in past 3 years). Income at or below 80% of AMI. Property in unincorporated Hillsborough County, owner-occupied as primary residence. Must complete county-approved homebuyer education.
incentive_amount: Up to $50,000 deferred second mortgage (forgivable after a residency period; consult HCFL for current terms)

description: Hillsborough County housing-rehabilitation program funded through SHIP and CDBG. Provides repair / code-compliance assistance for owner-occupied homes — roofs, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, accessibility modifications.
eligibility_criteria: Owner-occupied primary residence in unincorporated Hillsborough County. Income at or below 80% of AMI. Must be current on property taxes and insurance. Home must require structural / code-compliance repairs.
incentive_amount: Up to $50,000 in rehabilitation assistance (deferred-payment loan)

program_name: Florida Solar Sales Tax & Property Tax Exemptions
description: Sales tax and property tax exemptions for solar energy systems

program_name: City of Tampa Owner-Occupied Housing Rehabilitation Program
description: City of Tampa Housing & Community Development program providing forgivable loans to income-qualified homeowners for major home repairs — roof replacement, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, code violations, and accessibility modifications.
eligibility_criteria: Must own and occupy the home as primary residence within Tampa city limits. Household income at or below 80% of AMI. Must be current on mortgage, property taxes, and insurance. Home must be in need of substantial repairs.
incentive_amount: Up to $50,000 forgivable loan (forgiven after 10–15 years of continued owner-occupancy)

program_name: City of Tampa Down Payment Assistance
description: City of Tampa down-payment and closing-cost assistance for income-qualified first-time homebuyers purchasing within Tampa city limits.
eligibility_criteria: First-time homebuyer (no ownership in past 3 years). Household income at or below 80% of AMI. Property must be in Tampa city limits, owner-occupied. Must complete a HUD-approved homebuyer education course.
incentive_amount: Up to $40,000 deferred-payment second mortgage

description: FEMA's hazard mitigation assistance provides funding for eligible long-term solutions that reduce the impact of disasters in the future.
eligibility_criteria: States, communities, territories and tribal communities are eligible

program_name: Florida PACE (Property Assessed Clean Energy) Financing
description: Property Assessed Clean Energy financing for residential energy-efficiency, solar, hurricane resilience (impact windows, roof), and water-conservation upgrades. Repayment is added to the property tax bill over 5–30 years; the lien transfers with the property. Multiple PACE administrators operate in Florida (Florida PACE Funding Agency, RenewPACE, FRED).
eligibility_criteria: Property owner of single-family residential property in a Florida county/city that has authorized PACE. Must be current on property taxes and mortgage. No FICO minimum; underwriting based on home equity and tax-payment history. Mortgage lender notification typically required.
incentive_amount: Project-based — typically up to 20% of the home's market value with no fixed cap. 100% financing with no money down.

description: The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP) reduces energy costs for low-income households by increasing the energy efficiency of their homes, while ensuring their health and safety.
eligibility_criteria: Low-income households
